component.name: Obs Lite
component.summary: Record the screen using few resources

description.p: A lightweight screen recorder whose interface follows OBS Studio, so OBS users find everything where they expect it. It is not affiliated with the OBS Project.

ul.li: Records the screen or a window, chosen in the desktop's sharing dialog
Desktop audio and microphone, each with a meter, volume and mute
Pause, a region of the screen, screenshots and a webcam overlay
Replay buffer: keeps the last seconds in memory and saves them on demand
Global hotkeys, kept by the desktop
H.264 and AAC in MP4, on the GPU when it has an encoder

description.p: The interface is in Spanish or English, following the system language.

screenshot.caption: Recording, with the preview, the sources, the audio mixer and the controls

description.p: Recording with VA-API (Intel, AMD) keeps the frames on the GPU: about a quarter of the CPU it took, and half with a region and the webcam. Pausing no longer pauses the replay buffer, and many fixes for recordings that cannot be written.
Recordings survive a crash or a power cut, and are repaired at the next start.
